verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm a live llms.txt at sandbox0.ai/llms.txt (HTTP 200, with product content) and markdown variants of the docs pages (e.g. /docs/sandbox.md). Many documentation pages are served as .md files, so an agent can be pointed directly at agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: no first-party documentation describing the llms.txt/markdown-docs offering itself, and no evidence of an llms-full.txt or similar consolidated agent bundle.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: With auto_resume enabled, supported inbound access can wake a paused sandbox
